_comment: Emit config. Overrides paths with {} so workspace siblings resolve to their built dist/*.d.ts through the pnpm symlink, the way a real build orders them, rather than to source outside this package rootDir. An override is required: a key inherited through extends cannot be removed. src/cli.ts is excluded because it is a demo script, not library surface: it needs node globals, and shipping it made the package fail to build inside a fork whose install does not resolve @types/node for it.
